clues: This city sits in the north of New South Wales. It stands on a river bank, far north of Sydney.
Heavy rain in the river catchment can make the water rise fast and flood the town centre. Its worst flood on record came in 2022.
This place began as a farm for grazing stock in the 1840s. Boats on the river were the main way to travel, long before roads and trains.
One of three campuses of Southern Cross University sits in this city. That is a rare claim for a city to make.
The Bruxner Highway crosses the Wilsons River right here. That road and river crossing is a sure sign of this city.
